subject.title: [Feature]: Granular session visibility — split tools.sessions.visibility into per-capability knobs

question: Should OpenClaw add a per-capability `tools.sessions.visibility` object, or should send/read/list separation be handled by the existing A2A allowlist, session allowlist, and per-agent visibility proposals?
rationale: This changes the transcript privacy boundary and public config shape, and active related proposals overlap the same session authorization surface without one settled model.

options.title: Approve consolidated capability object
options.body: Adopt a backward-compatible object form for send/history/list/metadata after reconciling it with allowlist, per-agent, sandbox, and A2A semantics.

options.title: Use existing scoping proposals
options.body: Make the allowlist, per-agent, or A2A-send proposals canonical if maintainers decide they satisfy the send-without-read privacy goal better than per-capability flags.

options.title: Defer until adjacent work settles
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design question while related PRs and proposals are reviewed or closed.

recommendation.title: Approve consolidated capability object
recommendation.body: Adopt a backward-compatible object form for send/history/list/metadata after reconciling it with allowlist, per-agent, sandbox, and A2A semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current history on the shared session-tool authorization/config boundary and related security-scoping work.
